ply_loop_tip: No loop: play the list once and stop. Loop the list: start again from the top. Loop one song: repeat the current song. Shuffle: play the list in a random order, shuffled again each time round.
kb_port_tip:
Port
Which MIDI input of the unit the keys play into. A is the front MIDI IN A, where a keyboard was traditionally plugged in. C and D exist on USB only (parts 33-64).
kb_fixed_tip:
Fixed velocity
Off: the lower on the key you press, the louder (as on the other keyboards). On: every key plays at the velocity set here.
kb_octave_tip:
Octave
Moves the keyboard by an octave. The name is its lowest key (Yamaha's naming: middle C = C3). PageUp / PageDown do the same from the PC keyboard.
kb_bend_tip:
Pitch bend
Drag up or down; it springs back to the middle when released.
kb_mod_tip:
Modulation wheel (controller 1)
Stays where you leave it.
kb_keys_tip:
Press a key to play it; slide to move to the next key. Lower on the key is louder (unless Fixed velocity is on).
The PC keyboard plays it like a piano: Z X C V B N M are white keys with S D G H J as the black keys between them, and Q W E R T Y U I O P are white keys an octave higher with 2 3 5 6 7 9 0 as the black keys. The letters on the keys show which is which. PageUp / PageDown move the octave.
kb_knob_tip:
Assignable control
Pick which controller this slider moves (reverb send, chorus send, brightness and so on), then drag the slider. It sends on the port and channel chosen above. Other numbers: type one in the box next to it.
